messageView.description: A message as the AppView serves it, with its author, reactions and labels resolved.

rkey.description: The message's record key, for addressing it as a reply target.

channel.description: The channel space the message lives in.

updatedAt.description: When it was last edited. Absent means never edited.

parent.description: The message being replied to, or a stand-in when it can no longer be served. Never itself nested.

labels.description: Labels from labelers this community honours. `src` says who applied each one. A `hidden` label is enforced by the AppView, which withholds the message rather than serving it, so a message that reaches you carries only labels you are meant to act on for display, such as `spoiler`.

forward.description: Content this message was forwarded from, when it is a forward. Never itself nested.

suppressedEmbeds.description: URLs whose preview the author chose not to show.

legacy.description: Whether this message comes from the repo-backed community this channel was migrated from, and is therefore immutable.

forwardView.description: The frozen copy a forwarded message carries, with its source resolved as far as this AppView can. Never itself nested, so a forward of a forward reports the message it was forwarded from rather than a chain.

source.description: The message this content was copied from.

sourceName.description: Name of the channel or thread the content came from. Absent when this AppView does not know that space.

sourceCommunity.description: The community owning the source space, which is that space's authority. Absent when the source reference cannot be parsed.

createdAt.description: When the message this content came from was sent.

attachments.description: The copied files, served from the forwarding author's own repo.

deletedMessageView.description: Stands in for a message the AppView will not serve: deleted by its author, or hidden by a moderator. The two cases are deliberately indistinguishable, so hiding does not leak what was hidden. Render it as an unavailable message.

channel.description: The channel space it lived in.

attachmentView.description: A file attached to a message.

url.description: URL served by this AppView's blob proxy.

width.description: Intrinsic pixel width, when the file is a decodable image or video.

height.description: Intrinsic pixel height, when the file is a decodable image or video.

reactionView.description: Reactions to a message with one emoji.

viewerReacted.description: Whether the requesting user is among them.

unreadStatus.description: Per-channel unread state for the requesting user.

unreadMentions.description: How many unread messages mention the user.
